content.title: Vince withholds fiscal 2025 guidance amid dip in Q2 net sales
content.summary: US apparel and accessories retailer Vince has reported a 1.3% drop in total net sales for the second quarter and has withheld its full year 2025 guidance amid ongoing tariff policy uncertainty.

content.title: Tariffs Delayed the Fall Fashion Line at Upscale Brand Vince. It Wasn’t All Bad.
content.summary: Vince  typically sells lightweight cardigans, jackets, tops and other pre-fall items starting in June.  The result: Tank tops, dresses and other spring items remained in Vince stores, online and at wholesale without a markdown while the brand waited for the right moment to bring in the newer outfits and accessories.  “We were able to kind of extend out that full price selling window for our spring season products,” said Vince Chief Financial Officer  Yuji Okumura.
